name: numiq-desktop
description: NUMIQ de escritorio: facturación, gastos e impuestos en tu propio ordenador, sin servidor.
author: NUMIQ

scripts.dev: npm run app && npm run db && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run app && npm run db && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run app && node scripts/fetch-db.mjs --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run app && node scripts/fetch-db.mjs --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && node scripts/fetch-db.mjs --platform=darwin --arch=x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run app && node scripts/fetch-db.mjs --platform=linux --arch=x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --x64 --publish never
